description: Implementation of the WebAudioPlayerService class managing WebAudioPlayer instances, including creation, destruction, playback control, buffer management, device info retrieval, and volume control within the Rialto media server.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: Service class managing WebAudioPlayer instances, providing control and buffer operations.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance associated with the given handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback on the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback on the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream on the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves buffer delay in frames for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffer to the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred/max frames and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume of the specified WebAudioPlayer.
